quiz.0.question: What was the vineyard area of Alto Piemonte at the end of the 19th century?
quiz.0.explanation: In the late 19th century, Alto Piemonte had approximately 40,000 hectares of vineyards — today reduced to under 500 ha after phylloxera, world wars and rural depopulation.
quiz.1.question: What unique vine-training system does Carema use?
quiz.1.explanation: Carema's traditional Toppia system uses stone or concrete pillars supporting a pergola — the vines trained horizontally to maximise heat absorption in this cool Alpine environment.
quiz.2.question: What is the volcanic rock in Gattinara's soils?
quiz.2.options.1: Porphyry (reddish volcanic rock with granite-like mineral complexity)
quiz.2.explanation: Gattinara is underlain by porphyry — an ancient, iron-rich reddish volcanic rock — that contributes to the wine's distinctive mineral character and perfumed, iron-like complexity.
quiz.3.question: What is the total vineyard area of Boca DOC?
quiz.3.explanation: Boca DOC has only around 30–50 hectares of vineyards — one of Italy's smallest appellations. Its rarity, coupled with exceptional quality from committed producers, makes it a true collector's appellation.
